name: r1-convnext-cluster16-dsmem
author: solx-loop
description: H13 (lineage C, E3): give each image (two 7x7 images when B >= 8) a 16-CTA cluster, so the GRN dependency stays inside one cluster. Each CTA owns C/16 channels (dwconv, LN, output) and hidden slice j (4C/16), held fp16 in smem. LN statistics, the fp16 LN tile, the GRN mean and the GEMM2 split-K partials move through DSMEM, with no grid barrier and no global intermediates; both GEMMs use swap-AB mma.sync f16. Measured result: correct (16/16) and 36-73% faster than the anchor on the six 7x7/14x14
